videos.overview: Jordan and Fatima engage in ugly battles with Gary on Andi's behalf; Zac and Aaron bond over baby furniture; Karen and Pam make peace; Danni has a therapy session hoping to figure out her love life.

videos.title: Had It Coming
videos.overview: Andi's career is completely changed but her life  into turmoil when someone's life is at stake. Meanwhile, Sabrina's true desires come true.

videos.title: Dead Man Walking
videos.overview: Andi, along with the rest of her close-knit sister circle and even a few enemies, all have some explaining to do amid the fallout of Gary's brutal stabbing.

videos.title: Tea Time
videos.overview: The sister circle deals with the aftermath of the attack on Gary as they try to return to a semblance of normalcy, and Zac and Fatima decide to take the investigation into their own hands.

videos.title: Up Close & Personal
videos.overview: Andi struggles to deal with the fallout post Gary's stabbing when all her friends are interrogated by the FBI for their possible role in hurting Gary; Andi makes a confession to her friends.

videos.title: Showin' Out
videos.overview: Andi's attempt to see Gary is stopped by an indignant Hudson. Tony's surprise for Danni leads to a blow-up between them at work. Robin gives Fatima the worst boss she can imagine. An old rival returns to the bank and accuses Sabrina and Maurice of getting her fired; which brings out a new side of Sabrina. A disgruntled customer threatens Karen's salon.

videos.title: Wounded Eros
videos.overview: Andi becomes entangled in intense confrontations surrounding Gary, while Karen's business faces potential danger. Meanwhile, Sabrina is torn between her loyalty to her man and supporting her friend.

videos.title: Web of Deceit
videos.overview: Danni and Tony lay their cards on the table in public as Rich expresses his discontent with Sabrina's half-truths. Marie Willis puts Vanessa in her place and makes demands of Karen and Pam.

videos.title: Game Recognizes Game
videos.overview: Andi is forced into an all-familiar situation pertaining to Gary. Robin and Fatima faceoff, putting Fatima in a questionable situation. Meanwhile, Rich and Sabrina hash out their differences.

videos.title: Appearances
videos.overview: Andi's loyalty is questioned following Gary's recovery; Karen and Danni confront their views on love and past relationship struggles; Zac and Fatima team up for a covert mission.

videos.title: Missing Pieces
videos.overview: Zac learns information that could add a new suspect to the list of those who may have stabbed Gary. Penelope reveals to Jordan a condition she's been dealing with, possibly brought on by the trauma she's endured.

videos.title: Forget Me Not
videos.overview: Andi is caught off guard by Gary's unexpected appearance, leading her to reluctantly entertain his delusions; this creates tension among herself, Robin and Hayden.

videos.title: Breathe
videos.overview: Andi goes back to work despite Robin's protests and is met by a surprise when the partners put her on leave; they rescind her offer to be the new managing partner; later, she's attacked from behind in the parking lot.

videos.title: Pull The Trigger
videos.overview: While Danni and Karen face potentially fatal situations, Andi discovers Robin's hidden obsession and reclaims power; news of Gary's stabber spread quickly.

videos.title: Aftershocks
videos.overview: The Sistas reel from the shocking news of an arrest made regarding Gary's stabbing. Sabrina helps Danni with her issues and Karen has a surprising moment of intimacy.

videos.title: Knock Knock
videos.overview: Following her panic attack, Danni confides in an old friend about the chaos in her life; Fatima puts her plan to get evidence on Hayden into action; Andi questions Robin's motives and starts to regret asking for his help.

videos.title: Tectonic Shifts
videos.overview: Both Karen and Andi receive unexpected visitors, while Sabrina and Rich are given devastating news.

videos.title: Choose You
videos.overview: Agent Josh Watt makes promising threats to Zac and Fatima but changes his mind with a little convincing; Marie Willis confronts the Sister's Circle about their questionable decisions.

videos.title: Call Me by His Name
videos.overview: Andi agrees to meet with Jordan, Sabrina and Rich work through a misunderstanding, Danni escalates a fight with a coworker, and Fatima and Zac decide how to satisfy Agent Watt's demands.

videos.title: War to Roses
videos.overview: Andi and Jordan determine the future of their relationship, Danni receives grave news about her job, and Hayden handles an issue driven by his hidden truths.

videos.title: Knuckin' and Buckin'
videos.overview: Andi confronts Robin and the partners with Marie-Willis's help, demanding the job she was promised. Fatima's visit with Tamara has brutal repercussions.

videos.title: Boss Lady
videos.overview: Hayden humbly wishes Andi well on her journey; Sabrina confronts Tony about his misunderstanding with Danni, leading to an awkward encounter.

videos.title: Before You Walk Out of My Life
videos.overview: Andi must decide whether or not she wants to make things work with Robin before he possibly walks out of her life forever.

videos.title: No Time To Wait
videos.overview: The Sistas must put their current individual problems and traumas aside when they learn something is wrong with Karen's pregnancy; it's a mad dash to the hospital in a city recovering from a blackout.

videos.title: Do No Harm
videos.overview: With Karen's suffering being ignored by a dismissive doctor, desperation sets in as the Sistas search for a doctor who cares; when Karen receives the needed attention, a shocking discovery is made.

videos.title: Having Faith
videos.overview: A fed-up Sabrina takes control of her life and goes searching for direction on the wild side; Andi discovers deep, dark secrets during her deep dive into Dr. Cruise.

videos.title: One Is The Loneliest Number
videos.overview: Despite best efforts, Karen refuses any kind of comforting company while the rest of the Sistas confront their own individual problems as they all rear their ugly heads again.

videos.title: Heavy Is the Crown
videos.overview: As Sabrina confronts her betrayers and Andi digs into a grave case, Karen sinks deeper into postpartum struggles; Danni, Fatima, and Zac face unexpected turns that test their limits.

videos.title: New Normal
videos.overview: Maurice teaches a newly single Sabrina about the world of casual hookups, Andi encounters a setback in her legal pursuit of Dr. Cruise, and Zac finds comfort in an unexpected source.

videos.title: Cutting Ties
videos.overview: Zac and Karen bond as they reflect on their complicated past, Tamara gives Hayden a brutal wake-up call, and Maurice and Paige take Sabrina out on the town to find a new man.

videos.title: Truth Is
videos.overview: Sabrina embraces a bold new version of herself, throwing Rich and Andi off balance; as tensions rise between Zac and Fatima over pregnancy plans, Karen faces her fears of motherhood alone.

videos.title: Return To Sender
videos.overview: Zac reverts to his old ways when he allows jealousy  to creep in and lead him to confront on of Fatima’s clients; Karen surprises  Pam at the salon and finds it running a little different than she left it.

videos.title: Back Shot
videos.overview: Zac reverts to his old ways when he allows jealousy to creep in and lead him to confront one of Fatima's clients; Karen surprises Pam at the salon and finds it running a little different than she left it.

videos.title: Surprise, Surprise
videos.overview: Everyone's problems have to be put on hold when one of their own goes missing; the circumstances of this disappearance causes them all to fear the worst.

videos.title: Search Party
videos.overview: Gary begs Andi for closure, Chaz and Zac butt heads over Fatima, Maurice nervously welcomes Dylan to his home, and Karen's loved ones search for her and baby Faith.

videos.title: On My Own
videos.overview: When Karen disappears with Faith, a cryptic call sends Fatima on a tense search, as Aaron struggles to stay composed as doubts and guilt creep in.

videos.title: Pull Up On Me!
videos.overview: Some relationships become stronger when troubles arise, and some run from troubles right into new ones; the grass isn't always greener on the other side when you take care of the grass you got.

videos.title: Family Affair
videos.overview: Andi gets a surprise visit and an earful from her mother; Karen and Aaron plan for their future; Sabrina hesitates to take a chance on a new relationship.

videos.title: Unbreakable Bond
videos.overview: Maurice faces off with Paige about how quickly her brother, Dylan, seems to be falling for him; Gary continues trying to make amends, but he realizes it may all be for nothing when he gets cornered by Fatima, Zac, and Hayden.

videos.title: The Ties That Bind
videos.overview: Danni discovers Tony's destructive "hobby"; Andi slows things down with Dr. Vaughn; Sabrina sets ground rules with her latest hookup; Aaron has a romantic surprise for Karen.

videos.title: Diamonds Are Forever
videos.overview: There's the kind of power that corrupts with evil and the kind of power that binds with love; it's not always easy to see what kind of power people have; even a weakened bond can become more powerful if it's made with love.

videos.title: Taking It All Back
videos.overview: Andi and Karen present the stories of all those who suffered abuse under Dr. Cruise in an effort to solidify the case against him; the other Sistas seek justice of their own.

videos.title: Bon Voyage
videos.overview: The tension between Andi and Danni hits a boiling point at Karen's goodbye party, Maurice and Pam reveal their plans for the salon, and Andi faces an enemy after a night of confrontations.

videos.title: Girls Just Wanna Have Fun
videos.overview: It's Karen's going away party but, even with tensions between the Sistas, they'll always have each other's backs when somebody messes with the Sista circle. Sometimes, drama can still bring people together.

videos.title: The Hangover
videos.overview: After a night out, some wake up happy, some wake up confused and shocked; nothing could prepare the Sistas for whats to come after what was supposed to be a joyous send-off cookout.

videos.title: Next of Kin
videos.overview: In the aftermath of an explosive threat, it becomes apparent that Karen isn't the only Sista missing from the circle.

videos.title: Guilty
videos.overview: Guilt is like a bag of bricks that becomes harder to carry the more people pile on, especially with less sisters to help.

videos.title: With or Without You
videos.overview: Andi receives a call from the Police Station and is forced to act. Officer Green shows Danni his true colors after she turns him down.

videos.title: Safety Blanket
videos.overview: When a single act of violence shatters their world, a group of friends must confront buried truths, broken systems, and the silence threatening to destroy them from within.

videos.title: Misery Loves Company
videos.overview: As buried trauma resurfaces, Danni, Andi, and Fatima must unravel denial, secrets, and challenges of supporting one another through personal crises.

videos.title: Anything But Shy
videos.overview: Danni's friends gently coax her to open up, Andi shares her suspicions about Cruise with Hayden and Benson, Cheyenne enjoys her funemployment, and Zac gets bad news about his gym bid.

videos.title: Leaving To Stay
videos.overview: Cheyenne makes new "friends" at Andi's office, a grieving Maurice makes an impulsive decision at work, Zac and Fatima get revenge on Hayden, and Andi agrees to start fresh with Dr. Vaughn.

videos.title: Best Laid Plans
videos.overview: After opening up to Cretia, Danni learns she doesn't have decision-making authority in Sabrina's care, and Fatima gains new information about who might have bombed Andi's car.

videos.title: Visiting Ours
videos.overview: During a quiet dinner with Dr. Vaughn, Andi locks eyes with a familiar face across the room, setting off a chain of uneasy encounters and buried truths.

videos.title: Big As Us
videos.overview: Amidst a whirlwind of personal conflicts and hidden truths, Danni struggles to stay away from Officer Green, while those around her grapple with love, betrayal, and the weight of their choices.

videos.title: Three Sided Circle
videos.overview: Circles are a steady loop but there are still sides to every story and, when a circle is broken, the sides of a triangle become sharp and clear.
